description: This Java source file defines the ModelScreenCondition class, which models the <condition> element in a widget framework. It includes an inner class for handling 'if-empty-section' conditions and a factory class for creating condition instances.

classes.name: ModelScreenCondition
classes.description: Models the <condition> element in the widget framework, providing mechanisms to evaluate conditions based on XML elements and context.

classes.name: ModelScreenCondition.IfEmptySection
classes.description: Represents a specific condition that checks if a section is empty within the context.

classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of ModelCondition based on XML elements.
